item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json, copy; from work import evaluate; reqs=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); actual=[evaluate(r,policy) for r in reqs]; report=json.load(open('report.json')); assert actual==report; cases=[({'declared':['b','a','a','skip'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','meta':{'z':1,'a':2}},'b':{'kind':'missing'},'skip':{'x':1},'irrelevant':1},'current':{'a':{'meta':{'a':2,'z':1},'kind':'file'},'skip':{'x':2},'irrelevant':2}}, {'ignored':['skip']}, {'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}), ({'declared':['z','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'}},'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'},'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'3'}}}, {'ignored':[]}, {'needs_review':True,'changed':['a','z']})];\\nfor req,pol,expected in cases:\\n r0=copy.deepcopy(req); p0=copy.deepcopy(pol); assert evaluate(req,pol)==expected; assert req==r0 and pol==p0\\nprint('checks passed')\"]}"}
